description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a 10-person engineering team as its first product engineer in New York, working closely with the CTO in a hybrid setting. You will combine software engineering and product judgment to take customer needs from conversation through launch and adoption, including shaping how AI agents work alongside people.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Talk with customers, use the product firsthand, and turn ambiguous needs into simple solutions.

 - Build agents and full-stack features that connect models with tools, data, and customer-facing interfaces.

 - Develop workflows such as turning campaign briefs into contests and helping creators move from invitation to published content.

 - Test brand and creator experiences end to end, then improve them using customer feedback, usage data, and agent evaluations.

 - Use AI coding tools to accelerate development, verify their output, and collaborate through clear decisions, demos, and code reviews.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proficiency in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

 - Experience shipping and maintaining products across frontend and backend, including production-scale backend systems.

 - Experience designing APIs and web services and building customer-facing web application features.

 - Experience owning product work from customer conversations through launch and adoption.

 - Experience using AI tools to build agents or AI-powered features, and using AI coding tools with care and verification.

 - Based in or relocating to New York City, with availability to work in the office three days per week.

 - Experience in creator marketing or e-commerce, or experience at a large technology company, is relevant background.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $180,000 to $250,000 USD annually.


LOCATION

Hybrid, New York, New York, United States. The role works in the office three days per week.
